parcours.introParagraph1: There are no right or wrong answers here. There is your truth, and the truth you allow yourself to see.
parcours.introParagraph2: Answer with what you feel. Not with what you think you should say.
parcours.introParagraph3: Time does not exist here. The ancestor is waiting.

questionsAdulte.griot: Close your eyes for a moment. Think of nature, of what draws you in ways you can't quite explain.
questionsAdulte.q: Which natural element calls to you most deeply?
options: Fire dancing in the night — I'm drawn to its light, its unpredictable warmth, the way it transforms everything.
Water that never stops flowing — river, ocean, rain — I always come back to it.
The earth beneath my feet, the roots, the stones, the dense forests, what endures and holds firm.
The wind that carries everything away, open space, the heights, the horizon you can never quite reach.
questionsAdulte.fieldPlaceholder: An element, a landscape, a feeling that isn't on the list...

questionsAdulte.griot: I want to know where you truly stand. Not what you do, but where you live.
questionsAdulte.q: In which moment do you feel most alive?
options: When I'm protecting someone, fighting for what's right, right at the heart of the action.
When I'm creating something — an idea, a work, a project — when my hands give shape to my vision.
When I'm surrounded by those I love, in laughter, in sharing, in connection.
When I'm alone in nature or in silence, observing, understanding, seeing far.
questionsAdulte.fieldPlaceholder: Describe the moment you feel fully alive...

questionsAdulte.griot: Listen closely. What others see in you, without asking, is often what you refuse to see in yourself.
questionsAdulte.q: What do others see in you, without ever asking?
options: Strength. A presence. Someone people turn to when things go wrong, or when a decision must be made.
Wisdom. A different way of seeing. Someone who says what others don't dare put into words.
Gentleness. Warmth. Someone who welcomes, who listens, who brings out the best in people.
Freedom. Originality. Someone who can never quite be put in a box.
questionsAdulte.fieldLabel: The griot has listened. If you want to whisper a nuance to him, he will hear it.
questionsAdulte.fieldPlaceholder: A phrase people often say to you, one you love or one you'd rather not hear...

questionsAdulte.griot: A trial reveals. Not what we say we'd do, but what we actually do.
questionsAdulte.q: When facing a hardship, how do you really react?
options: I charge ahead. I act. I'd rather be wrong in motion than stay frozen in doubt.
I step back, observe, analyze, then choose the right moment and place to strike.
I reach out to others, I build alliances, I create support around me.
I turn inward, I search for the answer in silence before looking outside.
questionsAdulte.fieldPlaceholder: How you really handle difficult situations...

questionsAdulte.griot: There's an hour in the day when everything seems clearer. An hour when you're truly yourself.
questionsAdulte.q: At what hour does your soul truly wake up?
options: At dawn, when the world is still silent and anything feels possible, before others arrive.
In broad daylight, amid the fire of action, movement, encounters, the living noise.
At dusk, when the light shifts, when boundaries blur, when reflection becomes possible.
At night, when the world sleeps and I'm finally alone with my deepest thoughts.
questionsAdulte.fieldPlaceholder: The time of day you feel most truly yourself...

questionsAdulte.griot: Close your eyes. Imagine a place you've never set foot in, yet that already feels familiar. Which one is it?
questionsAdulte.q: What land do you recognize, without ever having seen it?
options: A savanna stretching to the horizon, baobabs against the sky, a drumbeat carried on the warm wind.
A dense, humid forest, vast lakes, mountains that guard the silence of origins.
A shore where the sea mingles with a hundred voices from elsewhere, a land shaped by crossings.
A distant land, a different climate, a place you can't quite name yet.
questionsAdulte.fieldLabel: Name this land if you wish to
questionsAdulte.fieldPlaceholder: A country, a region, a feeling or a place you imagine...

questionsAdulte.griot: Anger is sacred. It tells you what truly matters. What angers you reveals what you hold most dear.
questionsAdulte.q: What sets fire inside you, your deepest anger?
options: Injustice. Seeing the weak crushed by the powerful. Seeing truth trampled. Seeing rights violated.
Accepted mediocrity. People who settle for less. Wasted potential. Abandoned dreams.
Betrayal and lies. Hypocrisy. People who play a role instead of being real.
Destruction — of nature, of beauty, of memory, of what took centuries to build.
questionsAdulte.fieldLabel: The ancestors listen best to those who dare speak the words they keep to themselves.
questionsAdulte.fieldPlaceholder: What truly puts you out of yourself, what you fight against inwardly...

questionsAdulte.griot: Imagine that in a hundred years, someone speaks of you. What do they say?
questionsAdulte.q: What trace do you want to leave in the world?
options: I protected. I defended. I made the world fairer for those who came after me.
I created. I built something that would last — a work, a venture, an idea, a legacy.
I connected. I brought people together. I created bonds where there were none.
I revealed. I spoke truths no one dared say. I opened eyes.
questionsAdulte.fieldPlaceholder: What you want people to remember of your life, in a few words...

questionsAdulte.griot: Dreams speak. Not literally, but symbolically. What keeps returning in your inner world?
questionsAdulte.q: Your inner symbol — what returns in your dreams or your life?
options: Water — a river, an ocean, rain — something that flows, that carries away, that purifies.
Height — a cliff, a summit, a flight — a view from above, a perspective others don't have.
Fire or light — a flame, a sun, a flash of lightning — something that burns and illuminates.
Roots or forest — trees, earth, ancient paths — something deep and enduring.
questionsAdulte.fieldPlaceholder: An image, a recurring dream, a symbol that often returns in your life...

questionsAdulte.griot: Last question. The most important one. The ancestor is watching you. They see your whole life. Not what you've done, but what you carry.
questionsAdulte.q: If an ancestor could look at your life, what would they see?
options: A warrior who hasn't yet found their true battle. An immense strength waiting for the right moment.
A sage who speaks too little. A deep wisdom the world needs to hear more of.
A heart that loves too hard and not enough itself. A generosity that sometimes forgets itself.
A free spirit in a body trying to fit into boxes. A soul too vast for the limits placed on it.
questionsAdulte.fieldLabel: Tell them now what you've never said out loud.
questionsAdulte.fieldPlaceholder: A confidence, a truth, a word — something you've never said out loud...

sections.title: The Awakening
sections.text: Sixty thousand years ago, before the continents drifted apart in the memory of men, an ancestor walked upon red earth, the wind's mane in his eyes.

sections.title: Blood & Earth
sections.text: They say he never ran — he advanced, and the world stepped aside before him. His strength did not roar; it stayed silent, patient, like a fire smoldering beneath the ash.

sections.title: The Way
sections.text: You carry that same fire. The Ancestral Lion does not conquer through speed, but through the quiet certainty of his place in the world. Where others search, you already know.

history.title: In doubt

history.title: In struggle
history.reading: "The cowries fall open, turned to the sky — a week favorable to action. What you begin now will carry further than you imagine."

laMaison.title: A creation house
paragraphs: TOTEM ANCESTRAL is a creation house founded in Paris, at the crossroads of digital art and African memory.
We are not archivists, seers or genealogists. We are guides between who you are and who you could have been.

laMaisonPage.title: The house
laMaisonPage.subtitle: The Totem Ancestral Manifesto.
laMaisonPage.intro: TOTEM ANCESTRAL is an artistic studio founded in Paris by SENYCE PARTNERS. We create unique digital works, personal fables inspired by African cosmogonies, with the assistance of artificial intelligence.

sections.title: What We Believe
paragraphs: We believe that every human being deserves a story that reflects who they are. Not a truth. A fable. A work that celebrates, questions, and passes on.
We believe that artificial intelligence, when harnessed to serve artistic sensibility, can produce objects of memory, not content.

sections.title: What we don't do
paragraphs: We don't do science. Not genealogy. Not divination. Not identity. Not folklore.
We create art. To honor a loved one. To embark on a journey of self-discovery. To fuel the imagination.

sections.title: Our standards
paragraphs: Each piece is numbered, signed, and comes with a certificate. It will never be reproduced, reissued, or resold. It is your unique copy in the current collection.
Our benchmark is that of niche perfume houses and high-end jewelry: rarity, elegance, and precision.

laMaisonPage.closingQuote: “A work of art is never finished. It is simply entrusted to the one who receives it.”

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions About the Ancestral Totem Experience.

items.question: Is this a DNA test or a genealogy test?
items.answer: No. Ancestral Totem is neither a DNA test nor a genealogy service. It is an artistic fable: a digital work inspired by your answers to ten personal questions, created to celebrate the imagination, not to reveal the truth.

items.question: Is every work of art truly unique?
items.answer: Yes. Each box set is numbered, signed, and comes with a certificate of authenticity. No work is ever reproduced, reissued, or resold.

items.question: Is AI replacing the artist?
items.answer: No. Our creative teams establish the framework, the references, and the narrative arcs. Artificial intelligence is our tool, not our author.

items.question: How long does it take to compose?
items.answer: The questionnaire takes about fifteen minutes to complete. The results are delivered by email within fifteen minutes of submission (thirty minutes for the Family Totem).

items.question: In what format will we receive the work?
items.answer: You will receive a PDF scroll, a high-resolution PNG image, and, for Ancestral and Family, a 90-second MP3 audio file.

items.question: Can I gift a piece of art?
items.answer: Absolutely. Every order includes a free gift card, and you can specify a recipient at checkout.

items.question: Can the artwork be printed?
items.answer: Yes. The artwork is delivered in very high resolution, ready to frame, and printable up to A2 size.

items.question: Is my data protected?
items.answer: Your responses are used solely to create your work and are then securely archived. Fully GDPR-compliant.

items.question: Who is behind Totem Ancestral?
items.answer: Totem Ancestral is an artistic collective founded in Paris by SENYCE PARTNERS, at the intersection of African cosmogonies, literature, and digital arts.

items.question: How can we contact you?
items.answer: By email at contact@totemancestral.com or through our contact form. We'll respond within 48 hours.

ctaFinal.title: Your ancestor is waiting.
ctaFinal.text: Fifteen minutes to awaken it. A lifetime to carry it.

footer.tagline: The imaginary portrait of the African you could have been.
